summary: Ocular is a self-hosted personal finance tool designed to help you monitor and plan your budget across monthly and yearly cycles. It provides a straightforward interface for tracking your monetary allocation without relying on external third-party services. The project is distributed under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It suits individuals who want a private, self-hosted ledger for manual budget tracking across extended timeframes.
watchOut: With a modest community and codebase activity, you may encounter edge cases or need to rely on community support for troubleshooting.
deployNotes: Because it runs in Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your financial data and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
